title: Board data file
description: The shape of site/data/board.json, written by pipeline.publish and read by site/index.html. Owned by workstream A4; it is an internal format between the publish step and the page, not one of the shared contracts. A missing optional field means 'not stated'.

generated_at.description: Copied from the jobs file: when the role data was generated.

grades.description: True when roles carry pay-vs-market grades (publish --grades, the default).

scope.description: 'all' is a development build that includes unlisted companies. Never publish it.

left_out_company.description: Roles left out because their company is not listed.

left_out_function.description: Roles at listed companies left out because their function is not listed.

companies_provisional.description: Companies in this file whose climate tier is not yet approved.

new.description: Roles first seen in the last 3 business days (pipeline/publish/fresh.py).

new_since.description: The earliest first_seen date (Mountain time) that counts as new.

functions.description: Roles in this file per function, for every function in the taxonomy, in taxonomy order.

categories.description: Roles per company category (decision 23), for every category in the taxonomy. A role counts once in each category its company is in.

listed.description: Functions only: present on a function whose roles are kept off the public board.

default.description: Categories only: a category the board opens on (clean tech, decision 23).

companies.description: Keyed by company id. Only companies with at least one role in this file.

type.description: From the startup test (tools.validate.company_type): a label, not a listing rule.

provisional.description: Present when the tier has not been approved.

cats.description: The company's categories (tools.validate.company_categories): clean-tech first when its tier is core or enabling, then adjacent ones. Absent only for an unlisted company in a development build.

unlisted.description: Present only in a development build.

url.description: The posting on the company's own board.

fn.description: The role's function: an id from taxonomy.functions.

st.description: US states the role's locations name, as lower-case USPS codes. Keys of taxonomy.states.

nm.description: Only for a role with no metro area (states.place_class): in the US, outside it (every place carries another country), or unclear.

es.description: Of `st`, the states none of the role's metro areas lies in: 'Elsewhere in <state>' (states.elsewhere_states).

disc.description: Left out when the role has no discipline.

lvb.description: Present when the level was inferred from the years of experience the posting asks for, because the title states none. Absent when the title states the level.

yrs.description: Years of experience the posting asks for (the largest required minimum). Present whenever the posting states it, with or without lvb.

emp.description: Left out for full-time, the usual case, and for unknown.

pay.description: As the employer published it. Never an estimate.

seen.description: The day the role was first seen; only when it has no posted date (the page dates a role by posted, else seen).

sm.description: Where the posting's summary is: an index into `texts` in summaries.json beside this file (same generated_at). Absent when the posting has none.

new.description: Present when the role was first seen in the last 3 business days.

grade.description: This role's published midpoint against comparable published ranges: same role group and level (the role's own, or 'none') and pay period, in market m. Not a salary estimate.

m.description: Market compared with: a metro id, 'remote' or 'us'.

n.description: Other postings in the comparison group.

pct.description: This role's midpoint against that median, in percent.
